sentences.en: The increased cholinergic and decreased dopaminergic activity in the striatum is thought to be a cause of the parkinsonian state.

sentences.en: This apparent role of the cholinergic system in enhancing synaptic activity seems to be mediated by the phosphoinositide system.

sentences.en: Objective To measure the changes of central cholinergic nerve system in ovariectomized rats and the effect of estrogen.

sentences.en: Conclusion: The distributing charactristics of tree shrew forebrain cholinergic neurons were similar to those of rat and monkey.

sentences.en: It has been considered that basal forebrain cholinergic system has affinity with learning and memory.
